description: Community rankings from Klown Kollege YouTube channel and top player consensus. Updated 2026-06-12.

tiers.S+: Game-breaking, must-have. Prioritize these above all else.
tiers.S: Excellent, top priority for acquisition and investment.
tiers.A: Strong, worth investing in specific situations.
tiers.D: Weak, avoid unless you have nothing better.

radiant-warrior.good_for: Every single game mode. Stack 2-4 in every formation. Level 6 gives +20% elemental resistance to all allies.
radiant-warrior.strategy: Never merge your last 2 copies. Two level 3s are better than one level 4. Pair with Paladin for shield overlap (Radiant shield at 0s, Paladin at 10s = 2s overlap).
radiant-warrior.common_mistake: Don't put all your Radiant Warriors in the same row. Spread them across the formation so their shields cover more area. A common mistake is stacking them together and leaving flanks exposed.
radiant-warrior.must_read: War Inc: Rising Gem Guide — Wheel, Card Master & What to Spend On

frost-queen.good_for: PvP control mage. Excellent in Infinite War.
frost-queen.strategy: Keep two copies at all times. Never merge your last pair. One of the best control units in the game.
frost-queen.common_mistake: Don't run Frost Queen without a frontline. She's fragile and needs a Tank in front to hold enemies in her AoE radius. New players often throw her in the front row and wonder why she dies instantly.

bone-marksman.good_for: PvP marksman deletion. Hunting boss damage. Clan War dragon damage.
bone-marksman.strategy: Pseudo level-6 at level 4 — skill unlocks at level 4 instead of 6, making it the best early-investment mythic. Bone Shot deals 250% damage (~5K at level 4) every 8s, prioritizes enemy marksmen and mages. Place in 'money spot' (right side) of split formations. At level 4: 32K HP, 2K ATK (equivalent to level 6 Ronin). Prioritize getting to level 4 ASAP.
bone-marksman.common_mistake: Don't put Bone Marksman in the front row even though he has decent HP. He's still a marksman and enemy priority abilities will delete him. Keep him in the back row with a Tank in front.

necromancer.good_for: PvE king. Clan War dragon damage (up to 3.6M per hit). Hunting boss damage.
necromancer.strategy: Skeletons deal massive AoE damage but are fragile. Must pair with Goddess of War shielding to survive dragon AoE. ~45% more morale per dragon hit than normal units. Level 4: ~32K HP.
necromancer.common_mistake: Using Necromancer without Goddess of War. His skeletons are paper-thin without shielding. If you don't have Goddess of War, bench Necromancer until you do.

light-seeker.good_for: PvP destroyer. Stronger than Necromancer in PvP.
light-seeker.strategy: Holy Wash (innate): continuous AoE damage + heals to 100% when below 50% HP (~16K heal on ~32K HP). Light Volley (level 4): multi-shot + 50% attack buff (~1,000 damage boost). Pass on this hero if you can't get to level 4 — the skill unlock is essential.
light-seeker.common_mistake: Don't invest in Light Seeker if you can't get him to level 4. Below level 4, he's just a decent Mythic without his key skill. Save your copies until you have four.

goddess-of-war.good_for: Essential support in every game mode. Shields nearby troops.
goddess-of-war.strategy: Required to protect Necromancer skeletons and backline Oracles from AoE. Combo with Red Blade + Barbarian (all three jump). Foundational support unit.

mistral-archer.good_for: Best backline damage dealer. Strong in PvP and PvE.
mistral-archer.strategy: Keep multiple copies. Top-tier ranged damage. Invest forge stones when available.

oracle.good_for: Pound-for-pound best epic. Attack buffer in any formation.
oracle.strategy: Each Oracle gives 4% attack buff stacking up to 20 layers. 9 Oracles = 36% buff. 18 Oracles = 72% buff. Level 7 gives large skill range which is critical. Stack as many as you can. Best epic investment in the game.

ursa-champion.good_for: Best legendary to invest forge stones in. Level 7 is transformative.
ursa-champion.strategy: 0.5s stun. Invest forge stones to level 7. High priority forge stone target.

elven-archer.good_for: Best legendary range damage. Excellent forge stone target.
elven-archer.strategy: Invest forge stones to level 7. High priority ranged damage dealer.

darkmoon-queen.good_for: Strong mythic, one tier below Frost Queen.
darkmoon-queen.strategy: Mid-level priority. Good if you have extra resources but not a primary target.

ripple-wizard.good_for: Best energy battery in the game. Aqua Revival grants energy every 2.5s.
ripple-wizard.strategy: Aqua Revival grants energy to nearby allies every 2.5 seconds. Level 6 gives bonus energy on skill triggers. Excellent support mage.

flame-mage.good_for: Top single-target damage for Hunting and Infinite War.
flame-mage.strategy: Invest forge stones. Essential for Hunting boss damage. Strong in Infinite War.

poison-master.good_for: Carries early-mid Infinite War. 8-10 at level 6 is transformative.
poison-master.strategy: Build 8-10 level 6 Poison Masters to carry Infinite War progression. One of the best early investments.

bomber.good_for: Suicide unit. Dominates 2,500-5,000 trophy range. Cheapest way to get via uncommon fusion with gold.
bomber.strategy: Suicide unit dealing 3x base ATK damage. At level 7: stuns on death. Best in backstab/outflank strategies. Fuse level 6 uncommons with gold to get Bombs — cheapest method.

royal-archer.good_for: Strong in Hunting and Infinite War. Buy from Exchange Shop.
royal-archer.strategy: Buy from Exchange Shop for 4,000 coins. Strong single-target damage for boss fights.

jungle-ranger.good_for: Solid ranged damage in multiple modes.
jungle-ranger.strategy: Versatile ranged unit. Good in PvP and Infinite War.

starlight-apostle.good_for: Strong mythic, good target for summon events.
starlight-apostle.strategy: Good target during summon events. Solid mythic for PvP.

red-blade.good_for: Jump combo with Barbarian and Goddess of War.
red-blade.strategy: Jumps onto same target as Barbarian. Combo with Goddess of War who jumps to shield them. Requires the trio to work effectively.

barbarian-tyrant.good_for: Jump combo with Red Blade and Goddess of War.
barbarian-tyrant.strategy: Jumps onto same target as Red Blade. Combo with Goddess of War. Part of the Red-Blade-Barbarian-Goddess trio.

forest-scout.good_for: Best rare range investment. 2.5 tile radius at level 7.
forest-scout.strategy: Best rare troop to invest forge stones in. Level 7 gives excellent range. Worth taking to level 9.

flail-warden.strategy: Worth forge stone investment. Solid melee damage dealer for rare slot.

goblin-chef.good_for: Single unit with splash + 2s stun. Best stun duration in game.
goblin-chef.strategy: 2s stun is longer than Griffin Rider (1s) and Ursa (0.5s). 23K HP / 1,200 ATK. Worth forge stone investment.

paladin.good_for: Shield every 10s. Combos with Radiant Warrior.
paladin.strategy: Multi-unit with shields. Radiant shield activates at 0s (battle start), Paladin shield at 10s — 2s overlap. Worth forge stone investment.

frost-skeleton.good_for: On-death area damage + speed reduction. Synergizes with Bone Marksman, Gunner, Warden.
frost-skeleton.strategy: Synergizes with Bone Marksman, Bone Gunner, Bone Warden, Iron Bulwark. Worth forge stone investment for the speed reduction debuff.

rock-thrower.good_for: S tier in Infinite War. 8 troops = 8 targets.
rock-thrower.strategy: Excels specifically in Infinite War where multi-target is king. Less useful in other modes.

woodland-guardian.good_for: Self-healing tank. Clan War niche use.
woodland-guardian.strategy: Self-heals every 12s (30% HP + 3,000 fixed). Healing radius ~1.2 squares. Low HP/ATK for a tank offset by healing. Mythic priority #4 for mid-game.

iron-bulwark.good_for: New unit. On-death single-target damage prioritizing supports.
iron-bulwark.strategy: On death deals single-target damage prioritizing enemy supports. Reduces their attack speed. Bonus AoE if target's attack speed is low.

venospore-killer.strategy: Situational use. Not a priority investment.

melody-weaver.strategy: Niche support unit. Not a priority.

apprentice-mage.good_for: Filler if you have nothing better.
apprentice-mage.strategy: Use only if missing better rares. Not worth forge stones.

berserker.strategy: Multi-unit: each individual has ~4,600 HP (level 6), total squad ~36K HP, ~800 ATK. Falls off hard after early game.

woodshield-guard.strategy: Single-unit common. Completely useless. One of the most common beginner mistakes is using this unit.

fury-cannoneer.strategy: Unanimous F tier from the community. Level 6 Fury is still better than Blast Dwarf. Neither should be used.

swordsman.good_for: Best common melee. Good for early game.
swordsman.strategy: Multi-unit with splash damage. Best melee common. Upgrade one to level 7 for 100-gem achievement then stop.

archer.good_for: Best common range. Good for early game.
archer.strategy: Highest ATK among common range units. Multi-target. Upgrade one to level 7 for 100-gem achievement then stop.

gunner.strategy: Archer is strictly better. Never use if you have Archer.

snowball-thrower.strategy: Worse than Archer and Gunner. Never use.

demoman.strategy: Not worth using. Outclassed by better options.
